Director of Research & Chief Economist, International Growth Centre · Research Fellow,
Department of Economics, London School of Economics

t.dobermann@lse.ac.uk · www.timdobermann.com · Google Scholar: QSNCu9UAAAAJ

## Appointments

**Director of Research & Chief Economist**, International Growth Centre, London — *June 2024–present*

- Member of the senior management team, responsible for the development and expansion of the IGC's global research portfolio.
- Lead a team of more than twenty economists and support research and policy engagement across eleven country programmes.
- Advise senior officials across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.

**Research Fellow**, Department of Economics, London School of Economics — *June 2024–present*

- Postdoctoral fellow in the Economics of Energy & Environment programme.

**External Adviser**, Ministry of Energy and Ministry of Finance, Pakistan (unremunerated) — *2019–2024; 2026–present*

- Presented confidential analysis to the federal Cabinet and senior decision-makers on electricity tariffs, tax reform, and macroeconomic crisis response.

**Policy Economist**, International Growth Centre, London — *January 2017–August 2018*

- Managed research portfolios in Myanmar, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Jordan, Lebanon, and Afghanistan.
- Led the technical update of Myanmar's National Electrification Plan with the Ministry of Electricity & Energy.

**Country Economist**, International Growth Centre, Yangon — *June 2015–January 2017*

- Established energy and cities research portfolios with the government of Myanmar.
